scenes.text: Shopify now lets you *build a store* by *chatting*

scenes.title: What *changed*
lines: Oct 1: Shopify Canvas went live for every merchant. Describe the store to Sidekick and it writes real theme code.
Change a section, a color, a layout by typing. Desktop only for now.

scenes.title: The *money* use
lines: One-product stores used to need a theme developer or a weekend fighting the editor.
Prompt: 'Build a dark, minimal store for one handmade candle: big hero photo, reviews, FAQ.' Then sell.

scenes.title: *Tested*, not hyped
lines: No third-party themes or app blocks yet, so if your store leans on apps, wait.
It makes the storefront, not the product or the traffic. Source: TechCrunch, Oct 1, 2026.

scenes.title: The *cost*
lines: Canvas is included with Shopify. Trial: 3 days free, then $1 a month for 3 months.
After that, Basic is $39 a month, or $29 billed yearly.

scenes.text: Want the *one-product store* weekend plan? Comment *STORE* and follow.
